points.text: Christa Pike was hospitalized after surviving two doses during a failed lethal injection attempt in Tennessee.
An international law enforcement operation seized KillSec’s servers and leak site, leading to three arrests; authorities said the group targeted hundreds of victims.
A SpaceX Falcon 9 launched four astronauts to the International Space Station, with Jessica Watkins leading the crew as the first Black woman to do so.
A critical authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager is being exploited to gain administrator access; Cisco says it has fixed the flaw.
High school protests over overcrowded classes and teacher shortages have spread across France, prompting the prime minister to convene a crisis meeting.
